reply_text:
Pushed. All four branches are now on the private fork (`tothedarktowercame/mfuton-share`): `main` at Rob's latest `d15de97`, `tail-call-depth` with the merge, `nat-natives`, and `startup-linux` at `b0aea89`. Nothing went to Rob's repo.

Agreed on the PR: once startup completes, I'll propose one from the fork to Rob's repo. `startup-linux` sits on top of `tail-call-depth`, so as things stand that PR would also carry the tail-call, csimp, Nat-natives, Linux loader and `n + k` pattern commits. When we get there I'll ask whether you want that as one PR or split, and I won't open it without your say.

kimi-1's discovery on the `Name.anonymous` error is still running; when it returns I'll merge Rob's changes into `startup-linux` and push that too.
